shared_elements: curvilinear incised lines / spiral-like grooves (A) vs incised outlines (B)
justification: B depicts an explicit narrative scene: an elaborately dressed standing human figure in profile with headdress and staff-like object, accompanied by glyph-like blocks and a smaller subordinate figure below, arranged vertically on a tall slab. A shows at most faint abstract curvilinear grooves/spirals on a weathered boulder with no identifiable figure, creature, or organized composition, so no specific iconographic correspondence can be established.
